description: Pulse Wave 6.1.19 — Developer Branding to BS.Framework5253, NPCI UPI Custom Payments, Vinyl Widget Controls & Rewind/Forward, Playlist Top Ordering & Shuffle Isolation.

changelog.title: Developer Branding & Unified Identity
items: BS.Framework5253 Developer Identity: Updated all developer and creator credits in About and updater screens to BS.Framework5253 with official GitHub profile links.
Unified PulseWave Branding: Cleaned all legacy references to ensure cohesive PulseWave branding across the application.

changelog.title: NPCI-Compliant UPI & Custom Amount Support
items: Crash-Free UPI Payments: Formatted strict NPCI-compliant payment URIs (pa, pn, tn, tr, cu=INR, formatted am) launched in isolated chooser tasks to eliminate force-closes in FamPay, PhonePe, and Google Pay.
Interactive Custom Amount Input: Users can now enter any custom amount in INR or choose from quick preset chips (₹50, ₹100, ₹250, ₹500).
Clipboard Fallback Safety: Automatically copies UPI ID (burhanuddin08@fam) with toast confirmation if no UPI handler is available.

changelog.title: Vinyl Turntable Widget Controls & Rewind / Fast Forward
items: Restored Widget Controls: Unhidden the frosted liquid glass controls dock and track info pill on the vinyl turntable widget.
10-Second Rewind & Fast Forward: Added interactive -10s replay and +10s fast forward buttons directly on the turntable dock with immediate service seek dispatch.

changelog.title: Playlist Isolation, Shuffle Indicators & Sync
items: Strict Playlist Playback: Fixed outside radio tracks from injecting into the queue when shuffling or reaching playlist boundaries.
Clear Shuffle Indicator: Shuffle buttons across playlist headers and player queue now clearly display active status with shuffle_on icon and accent styling.
Informative Download Warning Badge: Tapping the playlist download warning badge now displays an explanation dialog clarifying incomplete downloads with retry instructions.
Active YouTube Playlist Sync: Added direct 'Sync with YouTube Music' option in the playlist menu to pull updated remote tracks and order on demand.

changelog.title: Library & Speed Dial Playlist Cards
items: Top Custom Playlist Placement: Prioritized custom-ordered playlists (e.g. 'my MP4') to appear at the very top of Library Mix and Playlists before the Liked playlist.
Speed Dial Fallback Artwork: Empty and local playlist cards now render a stylish playlist icon surface instead of appearing blank on the home speed dial shelf.
Push Pin State: Accurately reflects pinned status on home speed dial tiles.

changelog.title: Pulse Wrapped Sharing
items: Wrapped Share Button: Added 'Share My Wrapped' to the conclusion page of Pulse Wrapped, allowing instant sharing of your yearly listening stats.
Social Summary: Generates a sleek summary of total minutes, top song, and top artist for easy sharing to social media.
